posts.title: The Moving World
posts.description: If you look unto the world, you might notice that all stillness is temporary. Observe the light on the river cusps, the trembling songbird and the season’s song. And what of the stone, you ask? Happily, it has seen more earth than you and I, has come from somewhere and to somewhere will go with time. posts.title: Viva la Flores
posts.description: The faces on the wall watch me do all kinds of things for the sake of sanity. I tape flower vases back together, I bargain with tomorrow’s sun. Somewhere, a child walking to school steps unflinchingly on each pavement crack. Somewhere, a horse running wild, aimless, dashes its legs and knows it is done. Somewhere, a lover buries a lover. posts.title: Between Nine and Ten in the Morning
posts.description: At five years old I had begun to practice hiding. Someone kind would close her eyes and count to ten, each number a soft crack of the whip. As I darted herringbone I would hear nine called, followed by a miraculous phenomenon wherein time appeared to stretch. Nine and a half, nine and three quarters, nine and infinitely dissected infinities. I hid well. This morning, the sun slices through window
